title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: modernised Gallery view prioritises video on stage
summary: Hold: the central configuration paragraph implies that a Teams Rooms Pro licence is required, but Microsoft's licensing page also permits valid legacy Premium licences for Pro management capabilities. The rollout, default behaviour and documented portal route are supported; the impact rating also understates a change to default behaviour.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Setting the Gallery default centrally
claims.claim: Setting the Gallery default centrally in the Pro Management portal depends on a Teams Rooms Pro licence.
claims.quote: Starting October 2, 2023 all devices without Pro or Premium licenses assigned to them will lose access to the pro management capabilities until valid licenses are assigned to them.
claims.fix: Remove the sentence 'Setting the Gallery default centrally in the Pro Management portal therefore depends on that licence, while the on-device setting is described only in the release notes.' Keep the preceding comparison-table statement: 'The licences page lists "Remote configuration" as a Pro feature.' This avoids excluding valid legacy Premium licences that the same page permits for Pro management capabilities.

claims.claim: The documented generic device-settings route is Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Rooms / Phones > device > Settings > settings category > setting.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. Select the Settings tab in the device panel. Use the left navigation in the device panels to browse settings categories (About, Account, Meetings, Device, Network, etc.).

claims.claim: No API, Graph or PowerShell call for changing the portal device settings is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Teams Rooms Android Gallery prioritization device settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph/api teamwork device configuration settings Teams Rooms Pro Management. Read results and pro-portal-settings; no matching write operation.

claims.claim: A medium impact rating fits this change to the default room stage layout.
claims.quote: impact: "medium"; "room participants see a different default stage layout". The assessment scale defines high as "most users, or a change to default behaviour".
claims.fix: Set impact to 'high' and replace the impact rationale with: 'High. Room participants see a different default stage layout: video participants are prioritised without administrator action.'
